nodes.label: Q22: How Docker and Kubernetes help
Docker (packaging)
nodes.rationale: Identical environments, per-service runtime isolation, second-level startup that makes autoscaling and rolling deploys practical, and immutable artifacts — the image that passed tests is the image that ships. Matters far more with nine services than with one.

nodes.label: Multi-stage build and cached restore layer
nodes.rationale: The SDK builds and the ASP.NET runtime image runs — about a fifth of the size and no compiler in production. Copying .csproj files and restoring before copying source is the single biggest win in .NET image build times. Non-root user turns a code-execution bug into a contained one for a one-line change.

nodes.label: Kubernetes (running services)
nodes.rationale: Takes over scheduling, restarts, load balancing, rollouts and stable DNS from the application. Not required for microservices — VMs with systemd, Azure Container Apps, ECS or Nomad all work — and adopting Kubernetes and microservices at once is two hard migrations simultaneously.

nodes.label: Liveness vs readiness probes
nodes.rationale: Liveness must not check dependencies: one database blip would restart every replica, turning brief degradation into an outage. So /health checks nothing and /health/ready carries the database check; a startup probe buys slow starters (EF migrations on boot) time without loosening liveness for the pod's life. maxUnavailable: 0 only makes rollouts invisible because readiness is honest.

nodes.label: Kubernetes Service and DNS-based discovery
nodes.rationale: A Service named projects-api is reachable at http://projects-api:8080 from any pod and kube-proxy load-balances across ready pods — which is why the hand-built registry is switched off there.

nodes.label: Service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
nodes.rationale: Sidecars give mTLS, retries, timeouts, traffic splitting and traces without application code, replacing the Polly policies and correlation plumbing. Worth it at large scale; a lot of moving parts before that.
